backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the grocery store backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for products, orders, carts, bills, recharge orders, user profiles, shop status, and UPI settings with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping implemented feature IDs to their affected source files, component dependencies, and test IDs, covering banner redesign, shop status toggle rewrite, and admin page theme changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of each frontend source file's purpose and key implementation details, serving as a reference summary for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React PWA with meta tags for viewport, theme color, Apple mobile web app, camera permissions, Google Fonts, and a manifest link for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store defining app name, display mode, theme colors, and icon references for 192px, 512px, and 180px sizes.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle handlers for cache versioning.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes including home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin, billing, settings, search, my-orders, and wallet pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that protects admin pages by verifying a hardcoded credential-based session (stored in localStorage with 24-hour expiry) and checking if the caller is an on-chain admin. Renders children only when both checks pass, otherwise shows login dialogs and access-denied UI.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, supporting fields like name, category, price, unit type, barcode (with scanner), stock quantity, and image upload with progress tracking. Validates inputs, checks for duplicate barcodes, and submits to the backend via the useAddProduct mutation.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with inline stock editing, low-stock warnings, and delete confirmation dialogs. Uses useGetAllProducts, useRemoveProduct, and useUpdateProductStock hooks to manage product data.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that dynamically loads the Quagga2 library from CDN and uses the device camera to detect barcodes. Supports flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep audio, and a scan cooldown to prevent duplicate reads.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable, filterable table of past bills with options to view, print, or export bills as CSV. Uses the useGetAllBills hook and displays individual bills in a dialog via BillTemplate.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, displaying order items, totals, delivery charges, and a UPI QR code, with actions to print or share via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with Home, Search, My Orders, and Wallet links, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Floating action button fixed to the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the store.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-in cart drawer showing cart items, subtotal, delivery fee, and a checkout button, with a warning when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontally scrollable row of category filter buttons that highlights the currently selected category.
Static alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond 1km).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches render errors and displays an error message with stack trace details and reset/home actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying store name, contact info, Google Maps link, delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header with the store logo, shop open/closed indicator, cart icon with item count badge, admin dashboard link, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing image carousel displaying three promotional grocery banners with prev/next arrow controls and dot indicators, cycling every 4 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout wrapper that renders Header, Footer, and conditionally shows BottomNavBar and WhatsAppHelpButton for non-admin routes.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Compact mobile recharge UI showing operator icons (Airtel, Jio, Vi, BSNL, MTNL) that open a dialog form to submit a recharge order via the backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a UPI payment QR code image alongside the order amount and step-by-step payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component for a single product showing its image, name, category, price, a quantity selector, and an Add to Cart button that is disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Renders a responsive 2-column grid of ProductCards filtered by the selected category, with skeleton loading states and an empty-state illustration.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Displays a red alert banner with opening hours only when the shop status has been fetched and confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Alert dialog that appears when the shop transitions from open to closed (or is triggered externally), prompting the user to return to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin toggle switch that reads and optimistically updates the shop open/closed status via React Query, with loading and error-revert handling.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: Fixed floating button that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link to the store's support number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider component and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend actor, covering products, cart, bills, orders, recharge orders, and shop settings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system, and includes utility styles for touch, barcode scanner animation, and print layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed navigation for managing orders, products, bills, and settings, including stat cards, batch delivery grouping, and order status filtering.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing store administrators to update the shop slogan, configure a UPI ID for payment QR codes, and perform an emergency shop close action.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that lets staff search/scan products, manage a cart, and generate a printable bill with customer details.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout form that collects delivery details and payment method, calculates delivery fees, and places an order via API.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page displaying a hero carousel, shop status banner, category filter, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Placeholder page for order history, showing a coming-soon message with no functional content yet.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Post-order confirmation page that shows the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or cash-on-delivery instructions.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Placeholder page for product search, displaying a coming-soon message with no functional content yet.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static store information page showing contact, location, hours, delivery policy, services, and an embedded Google Maps iframe.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Placeholder page for wallet/cashback functionality, displaying a coming-soon message with no functional content yet.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, fonts, shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 3) tracking the grocery store app's current features, known issues, architectural notes, and pending fix requests including shop toggle persistence, banner replacement, admin panel redesign, and delivery badge logic.
